commands.description: Run Go tests with the race detector
Build the linux-x64 and linux-arm64 artifacts with Podman

arguments:
set -euo pipefail; root="artifacts/orchestrator"; expected=$(printf '%s\n' linux-arm64/orchestrator-tooling linux-arm64/seccomp/terrascale-default-v1.json linux-arm64/terrascale-orchestrator linux-arm64/ts-node linux-x64/orchestrator-tooling linux-x64/seccomp/terrascale-default-v1.json linux-x64/terrascale-orchestrator linux-x64/ts-node); actual=$(find "$root" -type f -printf '%P\n' | LC_ALL=C sort); test "$actual" = "$expected"; while IFS= read -r executable; do test -x "$root/$executable"; done <<'EOF'
linux-arm64/orchestrator-tooling
linux-arm64/terrascale-orchestrator
linux-arm64/ts-node
linux-x64/orchestrator-tooling
linux-x64/terrascale-orchestrator
linux-x64/ts-node
EOF
